name: Heiden (Germany)
description: Blue field crossed by two white horizontal stripes, charged at the centre with the yellow megalithic tomb of the municipal arms of Heiden; the fly edge is cut into three tongues.
history: By deed of the Minister of the Interior of North Rhine-Westphalia in Düsseldorf of 17 April 1956 the municipality was granted the right to bear arms, a seal and a flag; the banner is blue-white-blue 1:3:1 striped lengthwise with the arms above the centre.

features.role: megalithic tomb (dolmen) from the municipal arms
